💡 chegou | JavaScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: Quick and easy file sharing between a computer and a mobile device without the need for external apps or cloud services, primarily for local network transfers.
✨ Key Features: • Send and receive files, photos, videos, text, and links between PC and phone • Operates over local network (LAN) or via Cloudflare tunnel for cross-network access • No phone app installation required, disposable connection • Secure transfer with a token-based QR code • File dropping directly onto the terminal window
📖 Summary: Chegou is a command-line tool that enables seamless file transfer between a PC and a phone over a local network or via a Cloudflare tunnel. It requires no phone installation and operates with a simple QR code scan.
